source.note: top-500 exact table truncated to the shipped K; ranking was float32-refined and verified against brute force

headings.encoding: uint16 centidegrees, row-aligned with the directory
headings.note: each panorama's own spawn heading, so a match can be rendered at the framing the corpus was embedded at - view 0 looks along the road. Per-view vectors were never written, so this is what makes a like-for-like comparison possible without re-extraction.

projection.encoding: per chunk: rows x dims int8, then rows x float16 scale; decode as code * scale, then normalise and take a dot product for the cosine estimate
projection.method: uncentred SVD basis fitted to 200,000 sampled vectors, int8

accuracy.measuredOn: 4,000 random pairs of rows excluded from the fit
